title: Abba Toran
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman quotes Shabbat 122b: Shmuel came to the house of Ravin Toran. Rashi explains the name as a place-name. Hyman suggests that the man was tall and was called Toran, a mast, for that reason; compare Bekhorot 45b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rashi’s place-name explanation and Hyman’s tall-man comparison are distinct proposals. The supplied heading says Abba Toran, while the quoted passage names Ravin Toran.

The checked Shabbat 122b reads Beit Avi Toran, beside Hyman’s quoted Ravin Toran and his heading Abba Toran. Rashi’s whole comment says that Toran is a place. Bekhorot 45b supplies the tall-parent comparison. Hyman’s mast and tall-man explanation remains conjectural; these forms are not silently repaired or joined.
